repository.data_availability_statement: THE ARTICLE HAS NONE. grep for GSE[0-9]+, 'accession', 'deposit', 'github', 'zenodo', 'dryad' over the Europe PMC fullTextXML (98,120 B) and over the full 41-page SI text returns nothing but the phrase 'available free of charge at https://pubs.acs.org/doi/...' referring to the SI PDF.
repository.scRNAseq_deposit: NOT DEPOSITED, as far as the article states. And it would not help: a GEO/SRA deposit for Figures 4-5 would hold host lung-cell count matrices -- what the tissue does ABOUT the particle -- which is not a delivery value. The only cargo-derived quantity in that dataset is the aVHH pseudogene read count of Fig 4b,c, reported per transcriptional cluster for one LNP and with no per-formulation value table.
